---
title: "Intensity of selected proteins per condition"
output: html_notebook
---

Box plots of normalised intensities (FragPipe-Analyst) of selected proteins (YY1, DDX41, MKI67, MDN1, NPM1) per condition.

**Input:** `combined_protein_f.tsv`, `Normalized_matrix.csv`, `experiment_annotation.tsv` (public repository).
**Output:** `Marker_gene_ActD.pdf`.
**Note:** taken from the 2025-10-19 analysis.


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# setwd("path/to/data")  # folder with the input tables (see header)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dendextend)
library(viridis)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggprism)
```

```{r}
comb_matrix = read_tsv("combined_protein_f.tsv") %>% rename(., ProteinID = 'Protein ID', EntryName = 'Entry Name') 
Norm_Matrix = read_csv("Normalized_matrix.csv")  %>% rename_with(~str_remove(., ' MaxLFQ.Intensity_normalized_intensity'))
annotation = read_tsv("experiment_annotation.tsv")
```
```{r}
cvs_group<- Norm_Matrix %>%  dplyr::left_join(.,comb_matrix[2:4], by="ProteinID")  %>%
      tidyr::gather("sample", "Intensity", -Gene, -ProteinID, -EntryName)  %>%
      dplyr::left_join(.,annotation, by="sample")
```

```{r fig.height=44, fig.width=10}

 p <- cvs_group %>% filter(Gene == "YY1" | Gene == "DDX41" | Gene == "MKI67" | Gene == "MDN1" | Gene == "NPM1") %>% ggboxplot(., x = "condition", y = "Intensity",
                color = "condition",
                add = "jitter") +
                facet_grid( Gene ~ ., scales = "free") +
                #theme_prism() +
                  theme(legend.position = "none",
                        aspect.ratio = 1,
                      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
                    )
 p
ggsave2("Marker_gene_ActD.pdf")

```
